categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the electric power equipment business, with core segments including diesel generator sets (发电机组), power distribution equipment (输配电设备), specialized vehicles (专用车), and new energy and energy storage products. The company also provides engineering services and after-market maintenance services. Generator sets serve as backup power sources, mobile power sources, and alternative power sources across multiple industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in the development, design, production and sales of diesel generator sets with standardized, intelligent, and environmentally-friendly characteristics. Core technologies include intelligent environmental protection integrated power stations, hybrid energy systems combining diesel, battery, wind and solar power, and gas-fired generator sets. The company manufactures medium and low voltage switchgear equipment and has capabilities in system integration, engineering installation, and after-market services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include data centers, telecommunications operators, high-end manufacturing (semiconductors), power utilities, oil and petrochemicals, transportation infrastructure, ports, and shipping industries. The company serves as a leading backup power equipment supplier for IDC data centers and telecommunications sectors. Key end markets include telecommunications infrastructure, AI computing centers, semiconductor manufacturing, and financial institutions requiring high power supply reliability.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with domestic presence across 30 provinces and cities through multiple branch offices and service centers. International operations include subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore, with service networks established in Indonesia, Malaysia, and other Southeast Asian countries. The company also serves Middle East, Africa, South America, and Australia markets. Domestic revenue is concentrated in South China, East China, and Northwest China regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the power equipment supply chain. It sources core components (particularly diesel engines) from international suppliers including ROLLS-ROYCE SOLUTIONS (formerly MTU), integrates these with other components, and delivers complete generator systems and integrated solutions directly to end-users. The company also provides engineering services and after-market support, positioning it as a systems integrator and solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) consolidating leadership in data center and telecommunications backup power markets; (2) expanding into high-end manufacturing and semiconductor sectors; (3) developing new energy products including hybrid energy systems, gas-fired generators, and energy storage solutions; (4) advancing intelligent and environmentally-friendly product technologies; (5) expanding overseas markets, particularly Southeast Asia; (6) enhancing engineering services and after-market capabilities; (7) pursuing digital transformation and system integration capabilities to evolve from product manufacturer to comprehensive energy solutions provider.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of diesel generator sets and related equipment to end-users. Revenue streams include: (1) product sales of generator sets (92% of revenue); (2) installation and engineering services; (3) equipment and facility rentals; (4) new energy product sales; (5) after-market maintenance and support services. The company operates on a direct sales model with no distributors, maintaining direct relationships with major customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of few domestic listed enterprises in the diesel generator set industry with over 20 years of operational history. It holds leading market positions in data center and telecommunications backup power segments. Competitive advantages include brand recognition, product quality, technical capabilities, extensive service networks, and long-term supplier relationships. The company competes with other generator manufacturers on product performance, reliability, service quality, and system integration capabilities in a highly competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of RMB 1.274 billion (up 16.54% year-over-year) with net profit of RMB 35 million (up 8.45%). Total assets reached RMB 1.862 billion with shareholders' equity of RMB 871 million. The company demonstrates steady growth with expanding margins, though growth rates have moderated from prior years. Operating cash flow was RMB 100 million in 2024. The company maintains a healthy balance sheet with manageable debt levels.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) standardized, intelligent, and environmentally-compliant product design; (2) superior product quality and reliability backed by partnerships with leading international component suppliers; (3) comprehensive system integration and turnkey solutions addressing customer needs beyond basic equipment supply; (4) extensive after-market service network providing 4-hour response time and remote diagnostics; (5) technical expertise in specialized applications (data centers, semiconductors, telecommunications); (6) innovation in new energy and hybrid power systems; (7) strong brand reputation and customer recognition in high-reliability application segments.
